'''Kimm''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Scoundrel/Legends|thief]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="IC 501st" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Kimm, along with his companions [[Forrie]] and an [[Unidentified Bothan thief|unnamed]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]], were trying to steal [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] on a freighter park located on [[Quadrant G-80]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Kimm and Forrie boarded the freighter ''[[Cornucopia]]'' in an attempt to steal it, not knowing that six [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando]]s were aboard along with an [[Imperial commando/Legends|Imperial Commando]] and the freighter's [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. Both Kimm and Forrie were instantly [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the commando [[Niner Skirata|Niner]] and Null ARC [[Ordo Skirata]].<ref name="IC 501st" />
